nom: Exuviance Daily Resurfacing Leave On Face Peel

segments.oily: The one reviewer who identifies as having oily skin says the pads lifted excess oil without causing itchiness or redness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose skin is also dry and sensitive from medication, report softer skin with no added dryness; one whose dry skin turns oily without enough hydration found the peel worked best after a deep-hydration step the night before.
segments.sensitive: Self-described sensitive skin gets mixed results: several reviewers describe burning, redness, or breakouts, especially with daily use or on a first try, while others using it once or twice a week or every other day report no irritation, redness, or breakouts at all.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal skin reports no breakouts and a more even complexion using the peel every other day.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin describe a smoother, firmer, more radiant look after regular use, though one notes it can sting on small skin abrasions.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the peel against visible aging report firmer, smoother, more even-looking skin after several weeks of use; one older reviewer with sun damage and wrinkles liked the clean after-feel and wished she had used it earlier in life.
concerns.dehydration: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say daily use dries their skin out or leaves it feeling tight and recommend cutting back to two or three times a week, while others report the opposite — less flaking and better absorption of other products once it is part of the routine.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report none at all, or that pre-existing redness (including one case tied to fungal acne) faded with use; two reviewers with reactive skin instead describe instant burning followed by red, blotchy skin, or lasting redness on the cheeks.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer whose skin barrier had been damaged by a competitor's peel pads found this product gentler and better suited to sensitive skin, though she still noticed increased irritation after a month of weekly use.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers tracking discoloration report visible fading of dark spots, acne marks, or uneven tone after several weeks; one reviewer with freckles and sun spots saw no change, and one who applied it specifically to stubborn spots on her jawline and neck said it was too soon to tell.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin generally report fewer breakouts and less congestion after a few weeks, including one case of hormonal acne improving and another of no breakout during a usual PMS flare-up; a few describe brief purging (small white pimples) early on, and several note the peel stings specifically on active acne or sensitive spots even when it does not irritate the rest of the face.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers with oily or combination-leaning skin say the peel manages excess oil well, with one describing it lifting oil from an oily face without itchiness, though another notes her skin turns oily specifically when she skips hydration alongside it.

aspects.libelle: Tacky, sticky residue right after applying
Dries down clean with no pilling
High price for the amount of product
Minimal fragrance, valued by scent-sensitive users

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately this product does not work well for sensitive skin. I washed my face and used one wipe only once and my face instantly felt like it was burning then got red and blotchy. Washed my face again to remove product and feeling better.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the idea of these being pads as they are easy to apply to the skin and feel very nice rubbing in. I have very sensitive skin and this made me a little sensitive and broke me out a bit. I personally would only use one a week if you have sensitive skin or it's too harsh. But, I love the pads!

extraits.titre: Better than DDG but not 100% perfect for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have sensitive skin and was a bit hesitant to try this product out, as I tried out the DDG pads before and they damaged my skin barrier a bit, but these were definitely better and more suited for sensitive skin. I used them once a week for a month and they helped a bit with my discoloration, but I did notice some more irritation towards the end of the month so I will probably move to using them less often. Overall, worth trying out, price is definitely better than the DDG ones, did help with discoloration and overall made my complexion more even and brighter/glowier.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Let me start off by saying, I take several medications that make my skin very dry and sensitive. I also get acne when I change products. I've been using this peel for about a week and a half if not a little more and it's worked wonders. The first day it did sting a little but nothing too bad. I continued my regular skin care and didn't have high expectations. However, by day 3 or 4 I saw clearing of dark spots from acne marks as well as brighter complexion altogether. I've also noticed the need for less moisturizer at night since my skin is absorbing it much better. The container it comes with is glass and easy to open. The little pads aren't too thin so although they stick together they don't tear while separating. There really isn't anything bad I can say about it. I love it and will continue to use it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used at home peels in the past so I was excited about a daily peel. This was far more gentle than others, but you can still feel it working. I have normal skin and it did not cause any breakouts and my overall complexion looks more even. I opted to do every other day at night because it did make my skin feel very tight. If you're looking for a daily peel that doesn't cause redness and brightens your complexion, I'd give this a try!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I actually thought this was like a cleanser now a wipe. But really like it as a wipe you see how much it pick up. I liked that it did not leave my face red at all it actually left my face super soft. I have oily face and it after using it is like it picked up all the oil without the itchiness.

extraits.titre: Great for all types of skin types!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was surprised there was no scent at all! I've been using this product for a couple weeks to make sure that i saw a difference. I did! I am am older woman with sun damage, aging and wrinkles. I recommend this product because of the clean feeling i get after use. It is great before applying makeup as it dries quickly. I would have given this product the full 5 stars, except I didn't like the stickiness on my hand after applying the product. I would have loved to have been able to use this product during my younger years to avoid the sun damage and exposure i received.
